name: Fossil coral
definition: fossil coral, solitary or colonial, rough, polished or on matrix (a dead modern coral skeleton is F6.6.4.01).
reason: FossilEra category of its own; invertebrate group with no kind; organism group is the fossil choice level (memo 4b).

name: Fossil bivalve
definition: fossil clam, oyster, scallop or other bivalve shell, whole, opalised or on matrix.
reason: FossilEra category; organism group sellers open; no invertebrate kind covers bivalves.

name: Fossil brachiopod
definition: fossil lamp shell (brachiopod), loose, pyritised or on matrix.
reason: FossilEra category; brachiopods are neither molluscs nor echinoderms, so no kind covers them.

name: Bryozoan fossil
definition: fossil bryozoan colony (moss animal), such as Archimedes screw or fenestrate lace, on or off matrix.
reason: FossilEra category of its own; no invertebrate kind covers bryozoans.

name: Fossil crustacean
definition: fossil crab, lobster, shrimp or other crustacean, usually in a nodule or on matrix.
reason: FossilEra 'Crabs and lobsters' category (memo S1); one arthropod group sold together.

name: Fossil insect
definition: fossil insect or other terrestrial arthropod preserved in rock (an insect in amber or copal stays F6.3.5).
reason: FossilEra 'Insects' category; rock-preserved insects have no kind; amber inclusions remain an amber tag.

name: Fossil gastropod
definition: fossil snail shell (gastropod), whole, agatised or on matrix.
reason: FossilEra category; organism group with no kind; modern snail shells stay F6.6.1.

name: Graptolite
definition: fossil graptolite colony, usually on a shale slab.
reason: FossilEra category of its own; no invertebrate kind covers graptolites.

name: Fossil nautiloid
definition: fossil coiled nautiloid shell, whole, split or polished (straight nautiloids such as Orthoceras stay F6.3.1.03).
reason: FossilEra and UK Fossils (memo S29) sell nautilus apart from ammonites and belemnites.

name: Fossil sponge
definition: fossil sponge, whole or sectioned, loose or on matrix.
reason: FossilEra category; no invertebrate kind covers sponges.

name: Trace fossil
definition: fossil track, footprint, burrow, boring or coprolite left by an organism rather than its body.
reason: FossilEra trace-fossil category; leaf F6.3.4 Trace and microbial held only stromatolite.

name: Fossil mammal
definition: fossil tooth, bone or other part of a mammal, such as mammoth, cave bear or whale (`part` attribute).
reason: FossilEra category; vertebrate group with no kind beside dinosaur, fish and shark tooth.

name: Plant fossil
definition: fossil leaf, fern, frond, seed or cone, as an impression, compression or nodule (petrified wood is F6.3.3.01).
reason: FossilEra 'plant fossil' category apart from petrified wood; memo object 'fossil leaf' had no kind.

name: Fossil reptile, amphibian or synapsid
definition: fossil tooth, bone or skeleton of a non-dinosaur reptile (mosasaur, crocodile, plesiosaur), amphibian or synapsid.
reason: FossilEra groups these in one category; no vertebrate kind covers them (dinosaur kind excludes them).

name: Azurite
definition: copper carbonate hydroxide mineral specimen (blue crystals, nodules, with or without malachite).
reason: FossilEra species category; Strunz carbonates; mineral kinds are species sellers open (memo 4b).

name: Aragonite
definition: calcium carbonate (orthorhombic) mineral specimen (sputniks, clusters, flos-ferri).
reason: FossilEra species category; Strunz carbonates; distinct species from calcite.

name: Halite
definition: sodium chloride mineral specimen (cubic crystals, coloured or clear).
reason: FossilEra species category; Strunz halides beside fluorite.

name: Hematite
definition: iron oxide mineral specimen (specular, botryoidal or rose crystals, tumbled pieces).
reason: FossilEra species category; Strunz oxides.

name: Beryl
definition: uncut beryl specimen (aquamarine, morganite, heliodor, emerald crystals on or off matrix); cut stones are F6.5.
reason: FossilEra species category; uncut counterpart of beryl gems under the F-4 cut-state test.

name: Topaz (specimen)
definition: uncut topaz crystal or specimen on or off matrix; a faceted stone or cutting rough is F6.5.2.08, sharing its species_id.
reason: FossilEra species category; memo edge 5 names topaz in both F6.1 and F6.5; F6.1 half missing.

name: Turquoise
definition: copper aluminium phosphate mineral specimen (nuggets, veins on matrix, rough or polished, stabilised or not).
reason: FossilEra species category; first kind in Strunz phosphates; memo edge 2 files it as species.

name: Lapis lazuli
definition: uncut or polished lapis lazuli (lazurite-rich rock) specimen, with a Rocks alias; a cabochon is F6.5.
reason: Memo edge 2: seller treats it as a species, so F6.1 with a rock alias; FossilEra category.

name: Serpentine
definition: serpentine-group mineral or serpentinite specimen, rough, tumbled or polished, with a rock alias serpentinite.
reason: Sold on FossilEra's minerals page as its own category; edge 2 rule files it with minerals.

name: Feldspar
definition: uncut feldspar-group specimen (microcline, amazonite, labradorite, orthoclase, moonstone and sunstone rough or polished); cut stones are F6.5.
reason: Mineral group sold as its own category, like garnet (F6.1.9.02); named varieties become named forms.

name: Rhyolite
definition: fine-grained silica-rich extrusive igneous rock sample (including rainforest and wonderstone rhyolite).
reason: Rock type sold under its own name; igneous class; memo expects 50-70 rock kinds.

name: Porphyry
definition: igneous rock sample with large crystals in a fine-grained groundmass (e.g. Chinese writing stone).
reason: Rock type sold under its own name; igneous class; no kind covers it.

name: Fulgurite
definition: natural tube or crust of silica glass fused by lightning in sand or rock.
reason: Sold as its own category; not impact glass (F6.4.07); silica glass placed with quartz family, placement provisional.

name: HED meteorite
definition: achondrite of the howardite, eucrite and diogenite group, from asteroid Vesta.
reason: FossilEra and N's Mineral (memo S3, S7) both give HED its own category (C11 two regions).

name: Mesosiderite
definition: stony-iron meteorite of silicate breccia and iron-nickel metal in roughly equal parts.
reason: FossilEra 'Mesosiderites' category; stony-iron class beside pallasite; no kind covers it.

name: Achondrite
definition: stony meteorite without chondrules not covered by the lunar, Martian or HED kinds (aubrites, angrites, ureilites, primitive achondrites).
reason: FossilEra 'Achondrites' category; without it an aubrite or ureilite has no home; the chondrite split (section 14) stays.
An achondrite group, not a named fall; filed under the new Achondrite kind, group recorded as an attribute.
Presentation attribute (section 14 list; heart and pyramid proposed as values); cut-and-polished stone stays under its species (F-25).

candidate: stone lamps and carved animals (Mineraly Objets)
reason: Made objects leave F6: stone lamp B3, carved animal F2 or B4 (F-25, K-77).

name: Starfish (dried)
definition: dried whole starfish (sea star) kept as a specimen (a fossil starfish is F6.3.1.04; craft assortments C4).
reason: Sold by name in specimen lots; echinoderm leaf has coral and urchin test only.

name: Murex shell
definition: shell of a murex or rock snail (Muricidae).
reason: Popular family on Conchology and Catawiki lots; shell kind is the family (memo 4b).

name: Volute shell
definition: shell of a volute (Volutidae).
reason: Popular family at Conchology; shell kind is the family or popular group (memo 4b).

name: Brachiopod shell
definition: shell of a living-species brachiopod (lamp shell) kept as a specimen; fossil brachiopods are F6.3.1.08.
reason: Conchology popular group; brachiopods are not molluscs, so a new leaf value on the animal axis is needed.

name: Bird skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a bird kept as a specimen.
reason: Mammal skull is the only skull kind; skull sellers sell by animal class; home missing.

name: Reptile skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a reptile (alligator, turtle, snake, lizard) kept as a specimen.
reason: No home under mammal skull; Skulls Unlimited and Oddities sell reptile skulls apart.

name: Fish skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a bony fish kept as a specimen (a dried jaw or tooth set is F6.7.2.05).
reason: Skulls Unlimited 'Sharks, Rays and Fishes'; fish jaw kind does not cover a whole skull.

name: Articulated skeleton
definition: real animal skeleton cleaned and articulated on a stand or in a case; animal group is an attribute.
reason: Skulls Unlimited and Oddities sell skeletons as their own type; no kind covers a whole skeleton.
An articulated skeleton; the snake is the animal group attribute.

name: Claw or tooth specimen
definition: real modern animal claw, talon or tooth kept as a specimen (fossil teeth are F6.3).
reason: Skulls Unlimited 'Claws and Teeth' collection; no kind covers loose claws or teeth.

name: Taxidermy reptile mount
definition: reptile skin preserved and mounted as in life (full mount or head).
reason: Mounts are split by animal group (memo 4b); bird and mammal only; alligator heads sold as mounts.
A preserved whole-animal specimen; fluid or fixed preservation; animal group is an attribute (K-80).

candidate: preserved sea urchin / animals for dissection
reason: Preserved whole animals are the fluid-preserved kind; pack of 10 is `quantity`; an emptied test is F6.6.4.02.

name: Specimen frame case
definition: glazed floating frame or case made to hold and display one specimen; one holding several (Riker tray) is B1.
reason: Holder made for one specimen follows it (S3, K-9); dome, stand and box do not cover a frame.
Shop category matches the fluid-preserved specimen kind.
Emptied eggs are the egg or nest specimen kind (K-80).
Specimens in acrylic are insect in resin; pinned entomology is F6.7.3.01.
Amber with inclusions; inclusion taxon is a tag; copal insects F6.3.5.02.
Dried gorgonian skeleton is the coral skeleton kind.
